description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class for managing asynchronous tasks within the Global Task Framework (GTF) in the Superset project. It includes methods for creating, querying, updating, aborting tasks, and managing task subscriptions, with a focus on database operations and task state transitions.

classes.name: TaskDAO
classes.description: DAO class providing database operations for Task entities in the GTF, including creation, status updates, subscription management, and conditional state transitions.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a task by UUID, optimized for lightweight polling.

methods.name: find_by_task_key
methods.description: Finds an active task by type, key, scope, and user ID using deduplication logic.

methods.name: create_task
methods.description: Creates a new task record in the database with optional payload and properties, and auto-subscribes the creator.

methods.name: abort_task
methods.description: Attempts to abort a task by UUID, transitioning its state based on current status and abortability.

methods.name: add_subscriber
methods.description: Adds a user as a subscriber to a specific task.

methods.name: remove_subscriber
methods.description: Removes a user's subscription from a task and returns the updated task.

methods.name: set_properties_and_payload
methods.description: Performs a direct SQL update to set task properties and payload without reading current state.

methods.name: conditional_status_update
methods.description: Atomically updates task status only if current status matches expected, ensuring race condition safety.
